simple.summary: כִּלָּיוֹן (killâyôwn) means pining , destruction First listed occurrence: Deut 28 65.

definitions.full: H3631. killayon כִּלָּיוֺן noun masculine 1 failing, pining ; 2 annihilation (on formation compare Lag BN 200 ); — 1 construct עֵינַיִם כִּלְיוֺן Deut 28:65 failing of eyes (in longing, compare foregoing, and see Dr). 2 חָרוּץ כִּלָּיוֺן Isa 10:22 annihilation, strictly decided .
